method: Standard scratch ten-pin bowling scoring. An open frame scores the pins knocked down by its two balls; a spare scores 10 plus the pins of the next ball; a strike scores 10 plus the pins of the next two balls. Frame 10 grants bonus balls after a strike or spare, and its score is the sum of every ball thrown in that frame. Frames are read in the order entered, so a game in progress shows the total for the completed frames and leaves the rest unscored until their bonus balls are known. Handicap, fouls, no-tap scoring and split conversion are not modelled.
